newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Hariri to Tehran in June.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Hariri to Tehran in June.

text.p: Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri will pay an official visit to Tehran in June, Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati said after meeting Hariri on Wednesday.
"We handed him an invitation...to visit Tehran before the end of June," Velayati told reporters.
Hariri accepted this and another invitation from Iranian President Hashemi Akbar Rafsanjani to attend an Islamic summit in Tehran in December, he added.

On Tuesday Velayati handed Lebanese President Elias Hrawi an invitation to the Islamic summit. Velayati ended his brief visit to Beirut after meeting Hariri and drove back to Damascus en route for Yemen on the last leg of a regional tour.
